question.:question/problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix $U$, where

$$
U=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -7 & 0 \\ -4 & -4 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution: The matrix $U$ has $2$ rows and $3$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $2\times 3.$
